propositions: A stale 33 MB backup directory .bridge_state.bak-retarget is carried at tickets HEAD and must be removed to reduce fresh-checkout working-tree size by >=33 MB.
The deletion is a prerequisite that must land before epic 0303-692c's reclaim so the tree-identity assertion holds.
The deletion must introduce zero new fsck diagnostics, proven by an identical before/after diagnostic multiset (561 baseline) and a green read-only reconciler pass.

The acceptance criterion demanding an absolutely clean fsck is a plan defect, since STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED is intentional permanent audit evidence and must be replaced with a before/after-equality proof.
The live-Jira store-copy fixture hard-codes the deleted backup name and must have those references removed while preserving glob scrub and store-copy isolation tests.
No production consumer references bak-retarget, and the change requires no history rewrite and is revertible via commit f2837f0a8.
